announcements.title: Zoom mode and Screenshots rework
announcements.headline: A minor-version feature modal. The header should read "Update 1.4.0 - Zoom mode and Screenshots rework".

announcements.title: The big rebuild
announcements.headline: A major-version feature modal. The header should read "Introducing version 2.0.0 - The big rebuild".

announcements.title: This title must not appear
announcements.headline: A patch-version feature modal WITH a title. The header must read exactly "1.4.1 Patch notes"; the title must not be appended.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Patch form drops the theme even when a title is present.

announcements.title: Header with no version
announcements.headline: A feature modal with a title but no version. The header should show just "Header with no version", no prefix and no dangling separator.
A minor-version feature modal with no title. The header should read "Update 1.4.0" with no trailing separator.

announcements.title: Malformed version
announcements.headline: A feature modal whose version is not three numeric parts. The header should show the version and title joined as-is with no derived prefix, and must not crash.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Unparseable version degrades to a plain join.

announcements.headline: A feature modal with neither version nor title. There should be no header line at all; the logo carries the brand. Must not crash.

announcements.title: Minor banner
announcements.headline: A minor-priority announcement. It should show as a lightweight top banner with a dismiss control, no hero and no sections.

announcements.title: Warning tone
announcements.headline: A feature entry with type warning. Expect an amber accent, feature layout unchanged.

announcements.title: Critical tone
announcements.headline: A feature entry with type critical. Expect a red accent, feature layout unchanged.
